subject: FinPay discovery - next steps & MAP
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@finpay.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@finpay.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: FinPay discovery - next steps & MAP

Hi Alex / Sofia —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) to keep momentum:

1) Stakeholder map (from the call)
   - Economic buyer: Rahul Desai (CFO) — will sign off on budget/term
   - Procurement: procurement@finpay.com (tbd contact) — commercial T&Cs and PO
   - Security/legal: Sofia Ramos — security questionnaire and evidence requests
   - Technical lead: Alex Morgan — run technical deep-dive and PoC plan

2) Key decision criteria we heard
   - Response latency: p95 < 200ms for short-chat flows
   - Predictable unit economics for 6-month pilot (budget target: <$12k/month)
   - SOC2 + SSO + data residency assurances
   - Easy rollout path from pilot to production (can support dedicated capacity)

3) Proposed MAP & milestones (owners and suggested target dates)
   - Technical deep-dive (architecture + integration checklist) — owner: Dev Patel (Redwood), target: 2026-08-11
   - Security questionnaire + evidence delivery — owner: Neha Kapoor (Redwood), target: 2026-08-18
   - Procurement review & contract redlines — owner: FinPay procurement & Redwood legal, target: 2026-08-25
   - Pilot (4–6 week) kickoff — owner: FinPay + Marissa, target: 2026-09-08

I attached a first-pass MAP PDF (FinPay_MAP_v1.pdf) and a short SOC2 evidence summary. Please review and confirm:
- Are the stakeholders & owners above correct?
- Can you confirm the procurement contact for commercial conversations?
- Confirm two 60-minute slots for the technical deep-dive next week (I’ll coordinate with Dev).

Next steps from our side: I’ll ask Dev to prepare an architecture agenda and a rough cost estimate for a 6-month pilot, and Neha will pull the SOC2 pack.

Thanks — excited to move forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

Attachments: FinPay_MAP_v1.pdf, SOC2_evidence_summary.pdf

- Procurement: forwarding to procurement@finpay.com. If you can include a rough commercial estimate for the 6-month pilot (ballpark pricing and key assumptions), that will help speed internal approvals.
- I’ll confirm Rahul’s availability to join the procurement review — likely week of Aug 23.

Two times for the technical deep-dive that work for me:
  - Tue 8/11 10:00am PT
  - Wed 8/12 2:00pm PT

Appreciate the quick reply, Alex — attaching the MAP (v1) and the SOC2 evidence summary you requested (SOC2_evidence_summary.pdf). Longer SOC2 packages can be shared under an NDA if needed; the summary includes controls mapping and evidence pointers.

Pricing: Dev and I put together a ballpark estimate for a 6-month pilot (assumptions included in the MAP): ~ $9k/month for hosted usage (est. token volumes included) OR $18k/month for dedicated reserved capacity (if you need predictable latency at scale). We’ll refine after the tech deep-dive.

Dev — Alex suggested 8/11 at 10am PT or 8/12 at 2pm PT. Can you confirm availability for 8/11 10am PT?

Rahul / procurement — can you confirm who at procurement will own the PO and review timeline? If you prefer, we can send a standard SOW template and redlineable contract via DocuSign (I can drop a link once we have the contact).

Next steps (action items):
- Dev Patel (Redwood) to run technical deep-dive (8/11 10am PT) — agenda: integration points, SSO, data flows, latency test plan.
- Neha Kapoor (Redwood) to deliver SOC2 evidence summary today and coordinate further evidence by 8/18.
- Marissa to circulate MAP and HubSpot deal link.

Thanks — attaching files now.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: FinPay_MAP_v1.pdf, SOC2_evidence_summary.pdf

- Confirm availability for Tue 8/11 10am PT; prepare 45-minute tech agenda: integration options (API vs private deployment), KV/prefix caching implications, latency tuning plan, test dataset and success criteria. Also include a rough cost estimate for hosted vs dedicated for a 6-month pilot (ballpark numbers we can present tomorrow).

Neha (you):
- Pull the SOC2 evidence bundle and be ready to answer control mapping questions (data retention, access logs, encryption). I attached a one-page summary for them today; they may ask for more.

Rishi (you):
- Check current discount bands and any promo credit we can offer for a first pilot; confirm approval authority thresholds in case we need a quick discount decision.

I’ll own scheduling and the MAP doc edits. Keep replies short so I can forward updates to the customer.

Thanks —
Marissa
